SELECT f.*, u.name AS visitorName, u.phone AS visitorPhone FROM first_visit f LEFT JOIN user u ON f.visitor_id = u.id
AND f.status = #{status}
AND f.student_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{studentName}, '%')
ORDER BY f.is_emergency DESC, f.is_alert DESC, f.id DESC

SELECT f.*, u.name AS visitorName, us.name AS studentName FROM first_visit f LEFT JOIN user u ON f.visitor_id = u.id LEFT JOIN user us ON f.student_id = us.id WHERE f.student_id = #{studentId} AND f.status NOT IN ('已完成','已撤销')
